problem_statement: When VFS returns a directory entry, the name in vfs_dirent_t.d_name must be null-terminated and must contain the complete name, even for a name of the maximum length a filesystem can store. A test creates an entry with a name of that maximum length and expects vfs_readdir() to return the full name in d_name with a terminating zero. Today the returned name can be truncated or can lack a terminating zero.

verification.reason: The problem statement clearly describes the required behavior (d_name must be null-terminated and contain the complete name even at maximum length) and the current defect (truncation or missing null terminator). The tests check exactly these two observable properties. The agent can find the relevant filesystem readdir implementations, see the strncpy usage, and apply any correct fix (e.g., strscpy or manual null-termination) to satisfy the tests without needing any additional information.
